record.what_it_does: SE Ranking is an SEO/GEO data platform whose API gives programmatic access to keyword research, backlink, domain analysis, site audit, SERP, AI-search-visibility, and project-management data.
record.auth_notes: The REST Data/Project API uses a single per-account API key sent as `Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY` (or as an `apikey` query param) — this is a static bearer-style token, not an OAuth flow. The separately hosted MCP server (api.seranking.com/mcp) instead uses OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, or can accept the same API key/OAuth token passed in an `Authorization: Bearer` header.
record.access_notes: Every paid plan (Essential $?, Pro, Core $129/mo, Growth $279/mo, Business, Enterprise) includes a monthly Data API credit allowance and full Project API access, and a key is self-generated instantly from the dashboard — but the vendor's own FAQ says 'You can even test it in the free trial account,' implying ongoing/production use requires a paid subscription; there is no permanent free tier.
record.main_blocker: Production API access requires a paid SE Ranking subscription; the free trial only covers testing.

record.open_questions: Webhooks are not mentioned anywhere in the getting-started, reference, or OpenAPI-repo docs reviewed (site-audit jobs appear to be polled via `audits/status` rather than pushed), so webhooks=false is an absence-of-evidence call rather than an explicit vendor denial.
